name: armenian
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-large-v3 (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-30. A finetune of openai/whisper-large-v3, not a new base model: same config.json, 1.546B parameters against the base record's 1.543B (tokenizer/embedding rows resized). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence mit, repo created 2026-09-08. Whisper tokenizer replaced with a native Armenian tokenizer plus text multitask fine-tuning, so unlike the 'simple fine-tuning' BuzzASR siblings the tensor set is NOT the base's: params differ and the embedding/output rows were resized.
